Letitia Plummer

Democratic candidate for Harris County Judge, Harris County, Texas · Open seat

Former Houston City Council member

Won the May 26 Democratic runoff over former Houston Mayor Annise Parker with 51.1%. Incumbent Lina Hidalgo is not running.
